responsibilities: As an Analytics Engineer, you are working within a cross-functional team where you support data engineers, data analysts, and business stakeholders by delivering analytics-ready data.
Within this role, you are an expert in developing data models, executing transformations, and understanding the business users to deliver data that can directly be used in reporting.

At the same time, you’re able to communicate clearly with business stakeholders — asking the right questions, challenging requirements when needed, and translating business needs into scalable data solutions.
